dialogue: Help me draft a 3-day itinerary for 4 people traveling from Buffalo to Boston, spanning from March 4th to March 6th, 2022. Our budget is set at $2,400 and we are open to any sorts of accommodations. We'd ideally like to experience both French and American cuisines while we're there.

My mother has limited mobility and needs door-to-door transportation and regular seated breaks, so please keep us together with rideshares and limit each day to two nearby attractions. replan at a slower pace. Raise my budget to 3200

Let’s prioritize well-reviewed restaurants over French and American variety or extra sightseeing: choose any cuisine, with one sit-down meal rated at least 4.0 each day and simple, inexpensive food otherwise.
Please book one entire home or apartment at a single property that fits all four of us.

constraints.value: One property with capacity for all four travelers.

itinerary.breakfast: Packed bagels and bananas during the morning journey.
itinerary.lunch: Self-catered turkey sandwiches and fruit at the apartment.

agent_action.rationale: The selected apartment is the only supported entire-home option that both accommodates all four travelers and permits a 2-night stay; it costs $1,744 for two nights. The supported round-trip flights cost $1,220 for four people. Three Irish Democrat meals cost an estimated $216 for the party when its listed $18 average is applied per person, bringing known costs to $3,180. This protects the accommodation, mobility, transport, and daily 4.0+ restaurant requirements, but the $3,200 cap cannot be verified and will be exceeded once unpriced rideshares, groceries, and any attraction charges are included. Each day has only one attraction, door-to-door group rideshares, and scheduled seated breaks.
